subject: Request to create requisition: MLOps Lead (replacement) - approval to proceed
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to create requisition: MLOps Lead (replacement) - approval to proceed

Team —

We need approval to open a replacement requisition for a Senior MLOps Lead (IC5) on the Platform team. This is a backfill for the role Ravi covered; given the ramp of new infra work and support for Redwood Private, I’m requesting we move forward as quickly as possible. High-level: 

- Role: MLOps Lead (IC5) — technical lead for serving/runtime ops + infra automation
- Reason: backfill and capacity for Private deployments (regulatory customers)
- Target start: Q3 ramp (ideally onboard by mid-August)
- Proposed headcount id: REQ-2026-118 (provisional)
- Comp band: IC5 band (base $190k–$230k; total comp to be determined per candidate) — asking for confirmation from HR/comp

Attachments: MLOps_Lead_JD_v1.pdf, Comp_Band_IC5_2026.xlsx (attached).

Asks: 
1) Approve opening req so recruiting can create the Greenhouse opening and start outreach.
2) Confirm comp band and any funding constraints (Markus / Marissa).
3) Approve interview panel below so we can post quickly:
   - Hiring manager: Karthik Iyer
   - Tech lead interviewer: Mina Haddad
   - Systems architect: Markus Klein
   - Eng manager: Marissa Cole
   - Recruiter: Monica Patel

If we can sign-off within 72 hours I’ll ask Monica to post and kick off agency outreach (Priya from TalentLink is ready). If there are objections or redlines (banding, headcount freeze, or role scope) flag them here.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Director, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:03:42 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to create requisition: MLOps Lead (replacement) - approval to proceed

Karthik —

Thanks for the write-up. Monica here — recruiting is ready to go once we have sign-off. Quick notes / proposed timeline: 

- I reviewed the attached JD and made light edits (see inline comments). Main ask: call out Private/VPC experience and SOC2 familiarity.
- Proposed interview plan + targets: 6–8 week active search, 4–6 screened candidates, onsite loop (virtual) scheduled over two half-days.
- Sourcing plan: direct sourcing + TalentLink agency outreach (Priya cc’d) + internal referrals.
- Hiring panel listed in your note looks good; I recommend adding one engineering peer from runtime (I’ll suggest Jonas Weber or Diego Fernandez during scheduling).

Comp band confirmation: HR/Comp (Laura) — can you confirm that IC5 $190k–$230k is okay and whether we should set target offer at 75th for this role?

I’ll prepare the Greenhouse draft and post as soon as I get all approvals. Draft link (private): https://greenhouse.io/boards/redwood/jobs/REQ-2026-118 

Attachments: MLOps_Lead_JD_v1.pdf (with comments).

Next steps: Markus / Marissa — please reply with approve/decline and any band adjustments by EOD 6/20.

—Monica
Monica Patel

Karthus (cc team) —

Approve the req to open. A couple of constraints to note before you post: 
1) Please target offers with base not to exceed $215k unless there’s a clear need to go above and I sign off (we can use signing bonuses for specific cases).
2) No open relocation budget without finance pre-approval — if we need that, Monica please loop Finance.

Otherwise, happy to proceed — this is an important hire. Marking approved for Greenhouse draft.

-Markus

Thanks for the notes. HR/Comp confirmed the IC5 band and recommended a target offer at the 60–75th percentile for high-priority infra roles; the spreadsheet attached (Comp_Band_IC5_2026.xlsx) has the ranges and suggested target. A few compliance reminders: 

- Include the standard Redwood hiring checklist (background check + I-9) in the GH posting notes.
- For Private/VPC roles, add a clause about customer data handling and the KM integrations familiarity (KMS/HSM) — this reduces later security gating.

Given the business justification and Markus’s funding caveat, HR is OK to proceed. Monica — please include the hiring approval form in Greenhouse when you open the req and request final sign-off from Finance if relocation is requested.

-Laura
